title: WA Recovery Pro v2.0.6 — Clickable Links & Zero-Overflow Message Bubbles
changelog: 🔗 Clickable Web Links: Automatic URL detection with one-tap system browser opening and link badges
📐 Zero Bubble Overflow: Perfect word wrapping (word-break & overflow-wrap) prevents text leaking outside bubbles
📱 Responsive Text Clamping: Ensures long continuous strings and URLs stay cleanly confined inside chat cards
🚀 Instant Auto-Popup Update Engine: Seamless automatic update notifications on app launch
